review_policy: Reassess with actual GitHub billed-minute data before 2026-11-01; preserved source gaps must be explicitly classified.

cost_classes.NORMAL: eligible ordinary planned noncloud work if source admissible
cost_classes.CONSERVE: P0/P1 and materially valuable tasks only; no repeated cloud review
cost_classes.CRITICAL: required safety, essential observations and bounded blocking fixes only
cost_classes.UNKNOWN: no passive cloud or new spending until budget verified
